releases.body:
## [0.31.0] — 2026-11-17

### Bug Fixes

- **import:** Reject mixed wildcard/constant outputs that collide (#1106) ([@ShixiangWang](https://github.com/ShixiangWang)) ([#1106](https://github.com/Traitome/oxo-flow/pull/1106))
- **cluster:** Never panic when status cannot resolve a run directory (#1103) ([@ShixiangWang](https://github.com/ShixiangWang)) ([#1103](https://github.com/Traitome/oxo-flow/pull/1103))
- **cluster:** 128+signum exit on interrupt; surface checksum-task panics (#1102) ([@ShixiangWang](https://github.com/ShixiangWang)) ([#1102](https://github.com/Traitome/oxo-flow/pull/1102))
- **web:** Honor modern resource/env syntax in the agent validator (#1098) ([@ShixiangWang](https://github.com/ShixiangWang)) ([#1098](https://github.com/Traitome/oxo-flow/pull/1098))
- **cluster:** Honor --keep-going on the run --profile path (issue #1093 F2b) (#1099) ([@ShixiangWang](https://github.com/ShixiangWang)) ([#1099](https://github.com/Traitome/oxo-flow/pull/1099))
- **core:** Settle-hook coverage for re-entry failures + #1083 docs and parity pin (#1091) ([@ShixiangWang](https://github.com/ShixiangWang)) ([#1091](https://github.com/Traitome/oxo-flow/pull/1091))
- **cluster:** Re-queue interrupted rules and fold completions as jobs settle (#1087) ([@ShixiangWang](https://github.com/ShixiangWang)) ([#1087](https://github.com/Traitome/oxo-flow/pull/1087))

### CI/CD

- Fix AppImage AppStream validation and add a release-resume input (#1082) ([@ShixiangWang](https://github.com/ShixiangWang)) ([#1082](https://github.com/Traitome/oxo-flow/pull/1082))

### Documentation

- Remove internal campaign details and tighten the scientific narrative (#1097) ([@ShixiangWang](https://github.com/ShixiangWang)) ([#1097](https://github.com/Traitome/oxo-flow/pull/1097))
- Verify and sharpen the scientific/product narrative (#1094) ([@ShixiangWang](https://github.com/ShixiangWang)) ([#1094](https://github.com/Traitome/oxo-flow/pull/1094))
- **cluster:** Correct --keep-going guidance and add cluster flag surface (issue #1093 F2a/F3) (#1095) ([@ShixiangWang](https://github.com/ShixiangWang)) ([#1095](https://github.com/Traitome/oxo-flow/pull/1095))
- **cluster:** Tighten #1083 fold semantics (Skipped records never fold) (#1092) ([@ShixiangWang](https://github.com/ShixiangWang)) ([#1092](https://github.com/Traitome/oxo-flow/pull/1092))

### Features

- **web:** Populate paired_with in /api/data/analyze (#1104) ([@ShixiangWang](https://github.com/ShixiangWang)) ([#1104](https://github.com/Traitome/oxo-flow/pull/1104))
- **import:** Harden Nextflow/Snakemake translation and add migration guide (#1100) ([@ShixiangWang](https://github.com/ShixiangWang)) ([#1100](https://github.com/Traitome/oxo-flow/pull/1100))
- **web:** Expose --keep-going on run creation (#1101) ([@ShixiangWang](https://github.com/ShixiangWang)) ([#1101](https://github.com/Traitome/oxo-flow/pull/1101))
- **cluster:** Honor --provenance on the run --profile path (issue #1093 F1) (#1096) ([@ShixiangWang](https://github.com/ShixiangWang)) ([#1096](https://github.com/Traitome/oxo-flow/pull/1096))
- **engine:** Add [engine] dispatch_order for sample-aware dispatch ties (#1090) ([@ShixiangWang](https://github.com/ShixiangWang)) ([#1090](https://github.com/Traitome/oxo-flow/pull/1090))
- **cluster:** Make status/logs run-aware, add JSON and log fallbacks (#1088) ([@ShixiangWang](https://github.com/ShixiangWang)) ([#1088](https://github.com/Traitome/oxo-flow/pull/1088))

### Maintenance

- **knowledge:** Automatic knowledge refresh 2026-11-16 (#1086) ([@ShixiangWang](https://github.com/ShixiangWang)) ([#1086](https://github.com/Traitome/oxo-flow/pull/1086))
- **badge:** Refresh ghcr pulls badge ([@github-actions[bot]](https://github.com/github-actions[bot]))

### Refactoring

- **web:** Remove dead AI orchestration path (#1105) ([@ShixiangWang](https://github.com/ShixiangWang)) ([#1105](https://github.com/Traitome/oxo-flow/pull/1105))

### CI/CD

- Canonicalize lockfile registry URLs to registry.npmjs.org (#1077) ([@ShixiangWang](https://github.com/ShixiangWang)) ([#1077](https://github.com/Traitome/oxo-flow/pull/1077))
- Fix actionable CI warnings and dev-dependency advisories (#1076) ([@ShixiangWang](https://github.com/ShixiangWang)) ([#1076](https://github.com/Traitome/oxo-flow/pull/1076))

### Features

- Add a CPU-oversubscription guard and local resource budgets (#1080) (#1081) ([@ShixiangWang](https://github.com/ShixiangWang)) ([#1081](https://github.com/Traitome/oxo-flow/pull/1081))
